description: Yan Liang, tall chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. Bronze helmet with a green plume, brown lamellar armor with gold trim, a green sash, dark boots. He holds a great curved saber in the right hand
face: A stern face with a long dark moustache.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the bronze helmet with the green plume, brown armor with gold trim, a dark red back cloth, the curved saber at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: One diagonal downward cut. Frames 1-5 raise the sword and wind up; frame 8 the cut lands from upper right to lower left; frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b1: One level horizontal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is taken far out to the right at chest height; frame 8 it cuts across level to the left; frames 9-11 follow through on the left. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: One rising cut from low to high. Frames 1-5 lower the sword and coil; frame 8 the upward cut lands; frames 9-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Block, then a backhand cut. Frames 3-6 the sword is held across in front of the body as a block and the knees sink; frame 7 the sword swings to the LEFT hip; frame 8 a step forward and a backhand cut from left to right; frames 9-12 hold on the right. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The great curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Leaping downward cut. Frames 1-4 crouch and raise the sword; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground; frame 8 he lands cutting straight down; frames 9-11 absorb the landing.
actions.c1: Hidden low, then a rising cut. Frames 1-6 he folds the knees deep and hides the sword low behind the body; frame 8 the legs drive up and the sword cuts from below upward; frames 9-12 the body rises with it.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a1 → b1 → a2, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
